title: AUGUST 11 DEADLINE DAY! McBride & Towns Extension HOUR ZERO + Center Search STALLS!
description:
Today is August 11, 2026 - a critical deadline day for the New York Knicks. This is the last day they can extend Deuce McBride or Karl-Anthony Towns and still maintain the ability to trade them before the February 2027 deadline. As midnight approaches, neither player has signed. We break down what this means for McBride's $95M extension eligibility, Towns' $272M max contract situation, Josh Hart's patient waiting game, and the Knicks' stalled center search. Plus: historical context on extension deadlines that changed Knicks history, from the RJ Barrett decision that killed the Donovan Mitchell trade to the Kristaps Porzingis mistake. This is championship roster management in the second apron era - where sometimes the smartest move is the one you don't make.
